title.zh: 把开源模型当成一个端点

premise.zh: Fireworks 托管开源模型并按 token 计费，让你在不自建 GPU 集群的情况下切换模型。
premise.en: Fireworks hosts open models behind a per-token endpoint, so you can switch models without running GPUs.

narration.zh: 自建推理还是托管端点，差别不在模型本身，而在你要维护什么。
narration.en: Self-hosting versus a managed endpoint. The model is the same; what differs is what you maintain.

widget.input: serve an open-weights model to production traffic

body.zh: 自己开 GPU、按峰值容量规划、持续跟进推理框架版本，并在流量低谷时照付闲置成本。
body.en: Provision GPUs, size them for peak, keep a serving stack current, and carry idle cost between traffic spikes.

body.zh: 一次 HTTP 调用，按 token 计费。闲置不花钱，换模型只是改一个字符串。
body.en: One HTTP call, priced per token. Idle costs nothing; a model swap is a string change.

takeaway.zh: 对流量不稳定的产品，差别主要体现在闲置成本和切换成本上，而不是原始速度。
takeaway.en: For bursty products the difference shows up as idle cost and switching cost, not raw speed.

narration.zh: 按 token 计费意味着成本随用量线性变化。拖动看这条线的形状——数字是示例，用来说明关系。
narration.en: Per-token pricing makes cost move linearly with usage. Drag to see the shape — the figures are examples that illustrate the relationship.

formula_note.zh: 按 token 计费时成本随请求量线性增长；自建的成本由预置容量决定，和实际用量关系不大。
formula_note.en: Per-token cost rises linearly with volume; self-hosted cost is set by provisioned capacity and barely moves with usage.

value.zh: 随请求量线性增长——闲置时接近零
value.en: linear in requests — near zero when idle

value.zh: 固定且需预先承诺——用不用都要付
value.en: flat and pre-committed — paid whether used or not

narration.zh: 统一端点的实际价值：评估新模型的成本从一次迁移变成一次改字符串。
narration.en: The real value of a uniform endpoint: evaluating a new model costs a string change instead of a migration.

output.zh: 不论指定哪个开源模型，请求结构都一样
output.en: same request shape regardless of which open model you name

output.zh: 按 token 计费的补全结果

input.zh: 同一个 prompt，换成第二个模型 id
input.en: the same prompt against a second model id

output.zh: 同口径对比，不需要重新部署任何东西
output.en: a like-for-like comparison without redeploying anything

evidence.claim: Fireworks AI raised a $250M Series C in Oct 2025 at a $4B valuation, as a platform for open-source model apps.
